settings.text: A short list, on purpose. Here is what happens before a stick reaches your glass.

settings.title: Start from the label
settings.text: One short electrolyte base, then one addition per formula. If an ingredient does not pull its weight, it does not go in.

settings.title: Name every source
settings.text: Every ingredient is listed with its source, like Ancient Ocean® salt and CocOganic® Plus coconut water.

settings.title: Make it in the USA with internationally sourced ingredients
settings.text: Blended and packed in a cGMP-compliant facility in the USA, with ingredients sourced from the US and abroad.

settings.title: Print every milligram
settings.text: No proprietary blends. What the front of the pouch says matches the facts panel on the back.

settings.title: Every ingredient named
settings.text: With its source. No proprietary blends, ever.

settings.title: Sweetened with monk fruit and Reb M
settings.text: Monk fruit extract and Reb M, as listed on the label.

settings.title: Skip or cancel online
